title: RFK Assassination Files: 2025 Releases
summary: Under EO 14176 (signed Jan 23, 2025), RFK assassination files were released in tranches April–June 2025 (FBI/CIA/LAPD-related records). No verified primary-document support for the major conspiracy claims (second gunman, CIA involvement) has been reported from these releases.
tldr: Executive Order 14176 (January 23, 2025) ordered the full release of all federal records on the JFK, RFK, and MLK assassinations — directing the DNI and Attorney General to present a JFK release plan within 15 days and an RFK/MLK plan within 45 days.
ai_summary:
AI review of the full text of Executive Order 14176 (Federal Register, filed January 30, 2025), read in full:
- Policy: 'More than 50 years after the assassinations... the Federal Government has not released to the public all of its records related to those events. Their families and the American people deserve transparency and truth.'
- On JFK: the President determined 'the continued redaction and withholding of information... is not consistent with the public interest and the release of these records is long overdue,' after accepting agency redactions in 2017-2018 and 2021-2023 certifications.
- On RFK and MLK: 'although no Act of Congress directs the release,' the President determined release of all federal records on each assassination 'is also in the public interest.'
- Deadlines: within 15 days, the DNI and Attorney General present a plan for 'the full and complete release' of JFK records; within 45 days, the same for RFK and MLK records.
- DISCREPANCY: the record summary describes April-June 2025 release tranches (FBI/CIA/LAPD records) and their reported findings — but this primary source is the authorizing order itself, not the released files. Those tranche claims are not established by this document.
